arm_sweep.question: arm servo response with empty jaws
arm_sweep.metric: grip point and arm joint angle per commanded pose

drive_commands.question: mecanum drive response to issued commands (straight/strafe/rotate/reverse)
drive_commands.metric: displacement and heading change per issued command

idle_settle.question: resting scene bodies (painted boxes, beam, warehouse props)

pair_beam_hold.question: pair beam hold (two carriers, 0.30 kg beam)
pair_beam_hold.metric: per-robot grip slip, beam tilt, finger forces, formation drift

solo_carry.question: solo box grasp-lift-hold(120 s)-carry slip in the jaws
solo_carry.metric: grip slip in the cargo frame, creep rate, drop, placement error

solo_hold_load.question: same hold at 10x the load (creep-vs-load scaling)

wall_push.question: wall/obstacle contact behaviour (head-on, along-wall slide, escape)
wall_push.metric: penetration, normal force, along-wall slide, escape distance
